description: Thekedar lifecycle hooks for Codex. These mirror the Claude Code plugin hooks and resolve the target project from the Git root when possible.

hooks.command: PROJ="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; PLUG="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PROJ" CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$PLUG" bash "$PLUG/hooks/session-brief.sh"
PROJ="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; PLUG="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PROJ" CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$PLUG" bash "$PLUG/hooks/scope-guard.sh"
PROJ="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; PLUG="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PROJ" CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$PLUG" bash "$PLUG/hooks/secret-guard.sh"
PROJ="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; PLUG="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PROJ" CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$PLUG" bash "$PLUG/hooks/munshi.sh"
